postContent: Every Tuesday, a brass lighthouse logged the arrival of one lost teaspoon and played a short accordion tune at sunset.
Three striped clouds, one suspiciously square cloud, and a small fog bank were counted above the abandoned miniature-golf course.
Chapter one recommends that volcanoes send a postcard before erupting near a village bake sale.
A curator discovered that every umbrella in the east wing opens only when someone remembers a song from childhood.
The moon is quieter than advertised, but its rocks make excellent paperweights for floating grocery lists.
